host: ISRO Vikram lander / Chandrayaan-3 — not CLPS; flown 2023
lab_use: Do not size a night-store from ISRO hoping the rover would awaken. PIB printed one lunar daylight (~14 Earth days). Sleep-await is not Wh. The official mission page still says efforts underway — do not mint a closed no-signal from news. Not SLIM’s undesigned wake. Not Blue Ghost Mission 1’s 5 h after sunset.

quotes.text: The lander and rover are in sleep mode. Awaiting their awakening around September 22, 2023.
The lander and rover are designed to operate for one lunar daylight period (about 14 Earth days).
Post-landing, the rover moved around the landing site and covered ~101m distance.
